The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%) for several different methods. A black line, marked with circular data points, represents “Base”, starting at approximately 67% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and increasing to approximately 73% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A blue line, marked with triangular data points, represents “FT”, beginning at approximately 69% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and rising to approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A red line, marked with right-pointing triangular data points, represents “IKE”, starting at approximately 66% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and increasing to approximately 75% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A purple line, marked with diamond data points, represents “MEMIT”, beginning at approximately 72% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and increasing to approximately 78% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. Finally, a green line, marked with square data points, represents “ROME”, starting at approximately 75% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and increasing to approximately 81% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>.
